mil3.7.14:1.1: Rājā āha: Bhante Nāgasena, sakkā sabbaṃ sukhumaṃ chinditun-ti. - Āma mahārāja, sakkā sabbaṃ sukhumaṃ chinditun-ti. - Kim-pana bhante sabbaṃ sukhuman-ti. - Dhammo kho mahārāja sabbasukhumo, na kho mahārāja dhammā sabbe sukhumā, sukhuman-ti vā thūlan-ti vā mahārāja dhammānam-etam-adhivacanaṃ, yaṃ kiñci chinditabbaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ paññāya chindati, na-tthi dutiyaṃ paññāya chedanan-ti. -
